tests.name: patch_add_null_parent_object
tests.intent: Verify that applying a JSON Patch add operation to a null parent property throws out_of_range exception.

tests.name: patch_add_null_document
tests.intent: Verify that applying a JSON Patch add operation to a purely null document with a dash path throws out_of_range exception.

tests.name: patch_inplace_add_null_parent
tests.intent: Verify that patch_inplace throws out_of_range when adding through a null parent.

tests.name: patch_move_null_parent
tests.intent: Verify that a move operation targeting a null parent path throws an out_of_range exception.

tests.name: patch_copy_null_parent
tests.intent: Verify that a copy operation targeting a null parent path throws an out_of_range exception.

tests.name: patch_add_object_parent_success
tests.intent: Verify that adding to a valid object parent succeeds normally.

tests.name: patch_add_array_parent_success
tests.intent: Verify that adding to a valid array parent succeeds normally.

tests.name: patch_add_string_parent
tests.intent: Verify that adding through a string parent throws out_of_range.

tests.name: patch_add_number_parent
tests.intent: Verify that adding through a numeric parent throws out_of_range.

tests.name: patch_add_boolean_parent
tests.intent: Verify that adding through a boolean parent throws out_of_range.

tests.name: patch_remove_null_parent
tests.intent: Verify behavior of remove patch on a null parent (already threw 413 previously).

tests.name: patch_replace_null_parent
tests.intent: Verify replace patch operation on a path whose parent is null.

tests.name: patch_add_deep_null_parent
tests.intent: Verify adding with a deeply nested path containing a null parent throws out_of_range.

tests.name: patch_add_root_level
tests.intent: Verify adding directly to root (empty path) handles correctly.

tests.name: patch_test_operation_null_parent
tests.intent: Verify that a test patch operation behaves consistently with null values.

tests.name: ordered_json_patch_add_null_parent
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json also throws out_of_range when adding through a null parent.

tests.name: patch_multiple_ops_abort_on_null_parent
tests.intent: Verify that a patch with multiple operations aborts and throws out_of_range on the first null parent violation.

tests.name: patch_add_empty_path
tests.intent: Verify adding to an empty path string.

tests.name: patch_add_array_index_out_of_bounds
tests.intent: Verify adding with an invalid array index throws out_of_range.

tests.name: patch_add_missing_leading_slash
tests.intent: Verify patch path without a leading slash throws out_of_range or parse error.
